accounts.purpose: External identity subject and deletion state

entitlement_grants.purpose: Time-bounded tenant or member product capability

quota_ledger.purpose: Append-only idempotent unit reservations and releases

leases.purpose: Short-lived authorization for one member and private host

authorizationInvariants: Every resolved tenant object carries validated tenant, membership, host, device-key, pairing, and entitlement identity as applicable; missing identity fails closed.
Missing or mismatched tenant context fails closed and does not disclose object existence.
An actor must have an active membership in the request tenant.
Role assignment targets must be active memberships in the same tenant.
Admins cannot grant or revoke owner or admin roles.
The database atomically derives the tenant owner count from role mutations and rejects removal of the final active owner role without trusting a caller-supplied count.
Roles never imply terminal_access, premium, staff, or quota entitlement.
Lease issuance binds the requested pairing identifier to the exact resolved same-tenant pairing, membership, host, device key, and terminal_access entitlement before atomically reserved quota.
Pairing, key, entitlement, and lease validity are evaluated against a trusted server clock, never a client-supplied timestamp.
Subscription synchronization is a non-human provider-adapter action and cannot be authorized by a tenant role.
No platform role can decrypt, relay, observe, or silently authorize a tenant terminal stream.

leaseSemantics.replayBoundary: unique nonce hash plus lease state; agent rejects a consumed or expired lease
leaseSemantics.signingBoundary: private signing key stays outside the database; records contain only signing key id and token hash
leaseSemantics.transportBoundary: lease authorizes a direct browser-to-agent connection and is not a relay credential

retention.accounts: Delete external subject and normalized email after all memberships close; retain only irreversible audit actor hash where legally required.
retention.tenants: Soft-close immediately and pseudonymize direct fields after configured 30-3650 day retention. Retain an opaque tenant tombstone until child quota and audit retain_until boundaries pass, then purge it after all children.
retention.device_keys: Retain revoked public-key fingerprint for 90 days, then purge key material.
retention.pairings: Purge confirmation metadata 30 days after expiry, consumption, or revocation.
retention.leases: Purge token and nonce hashes 30 days after expiry; retained quota entries detach their lease reference and outlive lease rows without session content.
retention.quota_ledger: Remain append-only until retain_until. After that boundary a maintenance role may purge entries; ordinary application roles receive no update or delete grant.
retention.subscriptions: Retain hashed provider references only for the approved accounting period; no payment instrument data.
retention.audit_events: Retain allowlisted fields until tenant retain_until; no free-form payload column.

allowed: private host label and tailnet DNS name
pairing state and browser key thumbprint
lease claims hashes, timestamps, state, and signing key id
allowlisted audit action, outcome, resource kind, and correlation id
